name: NASA Mars Trek
role: Primary planetary map and layer-discovery portal
integration: Use the portal and its documented service endpoints to identify the local study area and layer products.

name: NASA Mars Trek MOLA ImageServer
role: Real elevation data for the Jezero development sample
integration: A bounded 256x256 GeoTIFF sample is stored in data/raw/jezero_mola_256.tif; scripts/fetch_resources.py can reproduce it.

name: USGS Astrogeology Interactive Mars Maps
role: USGS Jezero geologic context and cartographic reference
integration: USGS SIM 3464 Jezero geologic-unit polygons are stored as a simplified GeoJSON layer in data/raw/usgs/ and summarized in the Streamlit app.

name: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance Raw Images
role: Surface-view evidence for science targets and route waypoints
integration: A Sol 1934 SHERLOC_WATSON browse image is stored in data/raw/perseverance/ with provenance metadata; additional images should be selected with Sol, camera, image ID, and location.

name: Curiosity Proposed Path up Mount Sharp
role: Reference for combining mission routes with multiple science layers
integration: The NASA route animation is stored in data/raw/references/ with metadata and shown as historical context; it is not used as a live navigation path.
